Her element — californium: a silvery synthetic metal first made in 1950 by striking curium with alpha particles, and named for the golden western land and university where she was born, a land itself named after a legendary island of gold at the western edge of the world, ruled by a queen of warrior women armed in gold; one of her forms splits apart on its own, so a single microgram pours out over two million neutrons every second, an invisible spray used to kindle new nuclear reactors, to find hidden veins of gold and silver and pockets of oil deep underground, to spot concealed explosives and to fight cancer, and a single gram of her is worth tens of millions — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.
